name: RTX 5090 (32 GiB, SM120) - published reference numbers, not local measurements
notes: Reference-datapoint calibration: Hardware Corner's llama.cpp measurement (published via smeltcore.com 2026-06-27): 226.1 tok/s generation at 4K context, 7,093 tok/s prefill at 4K, Q4_K_M weights 18.56 GB. This is a PUBLISHED number, not a local measurement - the trust label must say so; the methodology's rule is to re-measure on your own host (P1/P2).
